sections.heading: 1. Data Sovereignty
sections.content: SmartKhata is a local-first POS application. All your business records, including sales, inventory, and customer data, are stored exclusively on your local device. We do not have access to, nor do we store your business data on our servers.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
sections.content:
To provide our services, we collect minimal information:
- Device Identifiers: Unique hardware IDs for secure license binding.
- Account Information: Email and basic profile details if you enable Google Drive sync.
- Technical Logs: Optional anonymous crash reports for system stability.

sections.heading: 3. Cloud Synchronization
sections.content: If you enable Google Drive backups, your data is encrypted and transmitted directly to your personal cloud storage. SmartKhata does not intercept or store this synchronization data.

sections.heading: 4. Data Security
sections.content: We implement industry-standard encryption for local storage. You are responsible for the physical security of your device and managing your system passwords.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights
sections.content: You have full control over your data. You may export, back up, or delete your entire database at any time through the application settings.

sections.heading: 6. Contact Information
sections.content: For privacy-related inquiries, please contact our data protection team at privacy@smartkhata.com.

sections.heading: 1. License Grant
sections.content: Standard licenses are granted for use on a single device. The software is licensed for commercial use within the scope of your purchased plan (Trial/Professional).

sections.heading: 2. User Responsibility
sections.content: You are responsible for the accuracy of data entered into SmartKhata. It is your obligation to comply with local trade, tax (GST), and accounting regulations.

sections.heading: 3. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: SmartKhata is provided 'as is'. We are not liable for any direct or indirect business losses, data corruption resulting from hardware failure, or misuse of the application.

sections.heading: 4. Software Updates
sections.content: Periodic updates are provided for stability and compliance. Major version upgrades may require a license renewal as per the prevailing subscription policy.

sections.heading: 5. Termination
sections.content: We reserve the right to revoke licenses found to be pirated, reverse-engineered, or used in violation of these professional terms.

getting_started.title: Getting Started
getting_started.content:
WHY: SmartKhata is more than just a billing tool—it's your business partner. Setting up your profile correctly from Day 1 ensures your tax filings (GSTR-1) and profitability reports are 100% accurate.

FROM SCRATCH:
1. Shop Identity: Navigate to Settings > Shop Profile. Enter your business name, full address, and upload your logo. These details appear on every printed bill.
2. Business Rules: Switch on 'GST Calculation' if you are registered. Set your 'Place of Supply' (State) to ensure correct CGST/SGST/IGST splits.
3. Hardware Setup: Go to Settings > Printing. Select your Thermal Printer (2/3 inch) or A4 Laser jet. Test the alignment with a 'Test Print'.
4. Load Inventory: Add your first product. For large shops, use the 'Excel Bulk Import' feature to upload thousands of items in seconds.

PRO TIP: Use the 'Onboarding Checklist' on the Dashboard to track your progress. A fully completed profile unlocks professional invoice themes.

billing.title: Billing & Sales (F2)
billing.content:
WHY: Your billing counter should be the fastest part of your shop. We've optimized every millisecond so you can serve more customers and reduce checkout queues.

FROM SCRATCH:
1. Adding Items: Use a barcode scanner (Instant) or press 'F2' to search by name. For loose items (like Grains), type the exact weight (e.g., 1.5 for 1.5kg).
2. Discounts: Apply a global discount to the entire bill or click an item to give a row-specific discount (Percent or Amount).
3. Customer Selection: Link a customer by typing their phone number. If they have a pending balance (Udhaar), the system will alert you.
4. Payment (F9): Choose 'Cash', 'UPI' (auto-generates a QR code), or 'Mixed' for splitting payments between methods.

PRO TIP: In 'Mixed Mode', you can record a partial payment and save the rest as 'Credit/Udhaar' for the customer to pay later.

inventory.title: Inventory Management (F3)
inventory.content:
WHY: Stockouts mean lost sales. SmartKhata's local database tracks every single unit so you know exactly what's on your shelf and what's gathering dust.

FROM SCRATCH:
1. Adding Products: Record the Product Name, Category, HSN Code, and Tax rate. Setting an accurate 'Cost Price' is essential for profit reporting.
2. Batch & Expiry: Enable 'Batch Tracking' in Settings for medical or food items. Record expiry dates to get automatic 'Near Expiry' alerts.
3. Low Stock Alerts: Set a 'Minimum Quantity' for each item. Products below this limit will automatically turn RED in the list.
4. Stock Adjustment: Use the 'Plus/Minus' icons to manually correct stock if you find items damaged or returned without a bill.

PRO TIP: Use the 'Stock History' icon on any product to see a complete audit trail of every unit added or sold, including the time and date.

customers.title: Customers & Udhaar (F4)
customers.content:
WHY: Relationship management is the secret to shop growth. Tracking 'Udhaar' (Store Credit) prevents revenue leakage and keeps your cash flow healthy.

FROM SCRATCH:
1. Quick Registration: Add customer name and mobile during billing. This builds your marketing database automatically.
2. Ledger View: Click any customer to see their full transaction history—every bill they bought and every payment they made.
3. Settle Balance (Got Money): When a customer returns to pay their debt, use the 'Settle' button. Choose the payment mode and the balance will update instantly.
4. Loyalty Tracking: See 'Total Spent' and 'Visit Count' to identify your most valuable customers.

PRO TIP: Tap the WhatsApp icon on the customer list to send a professional payment reminder containing their exact balance and your UPI ID.

purchases.title: Purchases & Suppliers (F7)
purchases.content:
WHY: You can't calculate 'Profit' without knowing what you paid. Recording purchases also populates your inventory and tracks 'Input Tax Credit' (ITC).

FROM SCRATCH:
1. Supplier Profiles: Add your wholesalers, distributors, or local vendors with their GSTIN.
2. Inward Entry: Record the Supplier's Invoice Number and the items received. This automatically increases your physical stock count.
3. Tax Reconciliation: Ensure the GST charged by the supplier matches what you record to ensure your CA can file for tax returns correctly.
4. Payables: Track how much money you currently owe to each supplier in the 'Accounts Payable' list.

PRO TIP: Use 'Convert to Purchase' when you receive a large shipment that you previously requested via a Purchase Order.

expenses.title: Shop Expenses (F8)
expenses.content:
WHY: Running a business has many costs beyond buying stock. Recording Rent, Staff Salaries, and Utilities is the only way to see your 'Net Profit'.

FROM SCRATCH:
1. Categories: Create specific buckets like 'Salary', 'Rent', 'Electricity', and 'Misc'.
2. Daily Logging: Record even small expenses like cleaning supplies or chai. Use the 'Record Expense' button (F8).
3. Payment Method: Track whether you paid the expense from the Shop Cash drawer or your UPI account.
4. Analysis: Check the Expense tab in Reports to see your highest spending areas month-on-month.

PRO TIP: Separate 'Direct Expenses' (like shipping) from 'Indirect Expenses' (like rent) to better understand your business's operating efficiency.

quotations.title: Quotations & Estimates (F9)
quotations.content:
WHY: For bulk orders or high-value sales, customers need a professional price estimate. Quotations build trust without reducing your current stock level.

FROM SCRATCH:
1. Preparation: Add items just like a bill. You can set a 'Validity Date' (e.g., this price is valid for 7 days).
2. Printing: Print a 2/3 inch or A4 'Estimate'. These do not have a Bill Number and are not counted in your daily sales.
3. Sales Conversion: When the customer returns to buy, search for the Quotation and click 'Convert to Bill'. It will instantly populate the billing screen.
4. Tracking: View 'Pending vs Converted' quotes to see your sales team's performance.

PRO TIP: You can customize the 'Quotation Terms' (like '50% Advance Required') in Settings > Business Rules.

barcode.title: Barcode Generator
barcode.content:
WHY: Scanning barcodes reduces manual errors by 99% and makes your shop look premium. If your items don't have barcodes, print them yourself.

FROM SCRATCH:
1. Item Selection: Search for any product and the number of labels you need.
2. Label Design: Choose to include the Product Name, SKU, and your 'Offer Price' on the label.
3. Printer Choice: Works with standard 2x1 inch sticky label rolls or 'Sheet label' printers.
4. Alignment: Use the 'Calibration' settings if the text is printing outside the label edges.

PRO TIP: Print a 'Barcode Sheet' for loose items like candy or heavy hardware and keep it at the billing counter for quick scanning.

reports.title: Business Reports (F5)
reports.content:
WHY: Don't guess—know. Reports provide the 'X-Ray' of your shop's health, from daily cash collection to annual tax summaries.

FROM SCRATCH:
1. Sales Summary: See 'Today's Collections' split by Cash vs. UPI. Perfect for closing the register at night.
2. GSTR-1 Helper: Download a pre-formatted Excel file that matches government portals, saving your CA hours of work.
3. Profit & Loss: Your (Total Revenue - Cost of Goods - Expenses) calculated instantly for any date range.
4. Stock Aging: Identify 'Dead Stock'—items that haven't sold in 60+ days—so you can run a clearance sale.

PRO TIP: Use the 'Trend Analysis' chart to see which days of the week are most profitable, and adjust your staff or inventory accordingly.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.content:
WHY: The mouse is slow. Power users navigate SmartKhata entirely via keyboard, shaving off 10-15 seconds from every customer interaction.

FROM SCRATCH:
• F2: Open Billing (Instant focus on Search).
• F3: Open Inventory to check stock.
• F4: View Customers and Udhaar Ledger.
• F5: Open Reports Dashboard.
• F9: Finalize/Pay the current bill.
• Ctrl+K: Global Search (Find any bill, customer, or setting).
• Esc: Close any popup or clear current search.

PRO TIP: In Billing, use the Up/Down arrows to select items and the 'Delete' key to remove an accidental item from the cart.

backup.title: Data Safety & Backup
backup.content:
WHY: Your data is your business's heart. Computers can fail, but your records should never be lost. We prioritize multi-layer data safety.

FROM SCRATCH:
1. Automatic Backups: Enable 'Auto-Backup' in Settings. Specify how often (e.g., every 4 hours) and how many copies to keep.
2. Cloud Sync (Google Drive): Link your Gmail account to silently copy every backup to the cloud. This protects you even if your PC is stolen.
3. Local Export: Periodically click 'Export Data' to save a .khata file to an external pen drive.
4. Restore: If you get a new PC, just install SmartKhata and 'Import' your latest backup file—everything comes back instantly.

PRO TIP: Always take a manual backup before performing a major Windows Update or changing your shop's computer hardware.
